# retake

> retake is a free, open-source (MIT) record/replay proxy for LLM APIs. It records the OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and OpenAI-compatible API calls an application makes, saves them as readable JSON "cassettes", and replays them in later test runs — offline, deterministically, byte-for-byte, at zero API cost. It is a single static binary written in Rust and works with any language, because it is an HTTP proxy that the official SDKs reach through the OPENAI_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL environment variables.

Key facts:

- Commands: `retake record -- <test command>` (real calls, saved), `retake replay -- <test command>` (served from cassettes; unrecorded calls fail with a 404 and a diff), `retake auto` (replay recorded, record new), `retake check` (validate cassettes, scan for secrets).
- Supports streaming (server-sent events replayed byte-for-byte), tool calling, structured outputs, the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs, embeddings, and the Anthropic Messages API.
- One cassette per test via the `x-retake-session` request header.
- Built-in dashboard: `retake ui` browses cassettes as readable conversations (messages, tool calls, thinking, token usage); every running proxy serves a live view at `/__retake/` showing each call as replayed, recorded or unmatched, with diffs.
- Request headers are never stored; API keys and tokens in bodies are redacted.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://zecrari.github.io/retake/install.sh | sh` (macOS/Linux), `irm https://zecrari.github.io/retake/install.ps1 | iex` (Windows), or `uses: Zecrari/retake@v0` in GitHub Actions.
- retake is not an evals framework; it makes tests repeatable. It complements evals and scheduled live runs.
